boundary.cli_prefix_hit_count_note: The existing CLI field counts one request even in cold mode; prefix_tokens and command arguments establish the actual cache mode.
boundary.scope: Actual GB10 token/logit boundary on the declared case. No unmeasured context, checkpoint, package, HTTP or retained-performance acceptance.

invalid_event_evidence.cause: Unresolved. Source records output-projection event6 before postnorm event7 on the same default stream, synchronizes the terminal event, and asks HIP for consecutive elapsed times. Status-only checks accept negative durations. No evidence here establishes event reuse, a driver fault, or a counter cause.

timing_limits: All phase observers were enabled; callback timing is not an uninstrumented retained-performance comparison.
Host linear and MoE walls are the current coarse progress evidence. GPU stage intervals are diagnostic and may include scheduling and overlapping work.
Shared MoE work overlaps routed work. Nested totals and coarse buckets must not be added together.
All ten attention event records contain an invalid postnorm duration; their positive subfields are not a validated complete additive breakdown.
The first decode GPU profile contains substantial negative durations; subsequent callback timestamps remain independently verified.

next_experiment.route: Widen routed candidate collection and keep a bounded persistent replay grid.
next_experiment.counting: 40 layers * (128 gate windows * 3 + 128 up windows * 4 + 512 down windows * 3); includes each device-count reset, collect, replay and up finalize. Count is derived from source, not an API trace.
